identity.name: Neo-Arcade Academy
identity.mission: Make math addictive for 12-year-olds by blending arcade aesthetics with serious learning.

usage.headings: Outfit - Use for all major titles. Bold and tight tracking.
usage.body: Inter - Use for all paragraphs and long text.
usage.ui_elements: Outfit - Use for buttons, badges, and navigation.
usage.math_code: JetBrains Mono - Use for equations and code snippets.

colors.rules: Use dark mode by default for the 'Game' feel, but allow a light mode toggle. High contrast is key. Never use muddy colors.

shadows.button: shadow-md shadow-purple-500/20 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-purple-500/40 transition-all duration-300

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlays on dark backgrounds to prevent banding and add 'arcade cabinet' feel.

layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A for Marketing, Mode B for Dashboard)
layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramping.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-bold shadow-glow transform hover:scale-105 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-semibold
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent/10 text-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-full px-4 py-2

cards.default: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-2xl border border-border/50 shadow-card hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors

inputs.default: bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary rounded-xl px-4 py-3

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }}
motion.micro_interactions: Button clicks should have a scale-down effect (active:scale-95).

media.icons: Use Lucide React for UI icons. Use 3D renders for 'Badges' and 'Levels'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards. Use lighter text on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-primary) are mandatory.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'Dark Mode' toggle but default to Dark for the 'Gamer' vibe.
Use 'Outfit' font for all headings to give a modern, friendly tech look.
Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Dashboard to show progress, badges, and next lessons.
Gamify the experience: Use progress bars, XP counters, and level-up animations everywhere.
Use the provided image URLs for the landing page and dashboard placeholders.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states and micro-interactions.
Do not use generic 'Bootstrap' layouts. Be creative with asymmetry and spacing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
